mapper.sql: id, title, file_name, file_path, file_type, file_size, chunk_count, status, create_by, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_doc (title, file_name, file_path, file_type, file_size, chunk_count, status, create_by) VALUES (#{title}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{chunkCount}, #{status}, #{createBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_doc WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM knowledge_doc WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_doc SET status = #{status}, chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_doc WHERE status = 'READY' AND deleted = 0
